pocket_text: All eight functions are negative and none has convincing focus; Helm and Archive are especially weak. Stewards, Flow and Craft are the least disabled channels, so the organisation improvises around care, exchange and making while authority, records and shared interpretation disintegrate into exhausted opportunism.

An immense command-and-production machine forms under invasion: Helm, Shield and Craft dominate focus, with Shield and Craft carrying the positive activation. Lore, Archive, Hands, Flow and Stewards all remain negative, so victory is organised as concentrated industrial and military effort at enormous civic and human cost.

A besieged command spends what little coherence it has on coercion: Helm and Shield retain large focus but highly negative activation. Flow and Stewards have the least negative sigma only because both have collapsed in focus, while Hands and Lore are exhausted; survival is organised through rationing, seizure and improvised exchange.

Every function loses nerve at once; Shield and Helm no longer supply confident leadership. Craft and Flow are the least damaged channels, so concession and practical rearrangement become the way through a general breakdown of authority, information and livelihood.

The archive is now the only positively activated function while Shield, Helm, Flow and Hands are all negative. Lore and Craft remain focused but strained: the personality is a wartime narrator and record-keeper trying to hold a coherent account as protection, command and everyday circulation consume trust and energy.

The state regains its footing as a guarded developer: Shield leads a positively activated Craft, with Flow and Stewards supporting growth. Helm is less dominant than before, Lore remains moderately engaged, and Hands is almost flat, making recovery real at the top but weakly shared at the bottom.

A formidable director and guard return, but the director's energy is slightly negative and the guard supplies the positive drive. Lore and Archive remain resistant, Craft is subdued, and Flow only just revives: this is a tightly supervised convalescence in which markets breathe more easily than ideas or labour.

A comfortable, guarded establishment now has all functions in positive activation, led by Shield and Craft with Archive and Lore close behind. Flow and Stewards are the weakest participants, giving a settled but top-heavy personality that maintains stability and production while circulation and care improve less convincingly.

A stern bailiff reasserts control, with Shield far ahead and Helm securely second. Stewards, Archive, Craft and Flow are mildly supportive, but Lore turns against the official story and Hands is heavily depleted: order is maintained while trust in words and ordinary participation deteriorates.

The guard becomes the dominant personality, backed by Archive and a highly focused Helm. Lore remains active but comparatively restrained, while Hands, Flow and Craft lose energy: this is a patriotic custodian curating the national story and hardening the perimeter as ordinary circulation and making strain.

The guard and the filing cabinet take over as other functions weaken: Shield and Archive lead, Helm and Craft are merely modest, and Flow turns slightly negative. It is a custodial personality, orderly and self-preserving rather than inert, with the outward appearance of capability but little new movement.

The engineer and the storyteller break out of the fortress together: Craft, Shield, Lore and Helm are all strongly positive, with Archive and Flow also contributing. Stewards still trails, so this is an exuberant, experiment-minded moderniser whose imagination and technical confidence outrun humdrum provision.

Lore still speaks with energy while nearly the whole governing and provisioning body fails. Helm and Archive are deeply negative, Craft, Hands, Flow and Stewards also lose activation, and Shield is only slightly positive: the personality is a public unmasking of a system whose centre can no longer convert speech into coordinated life.

The speaker suddenly seizes the platform from the administrator: Lore leads by a wide activation margin, Shield remains positive, and Craft and Stewards show tentative life. Helm, Archive, Hands and Flow turn negative, making this an argumentative reformer whose words and exposure of problems outrun its ability to execute and supply.

The director returns to the centre with Shield beside it, Flow and Stewards newly useful, and Archive and Craft moderately engaged. Lore is conspicuously faint beside the others: this is a confident consolidator exchanging open argument for order, rising circulation and restored command.

The organisation emerges as a heavily armed engineer: Shield has overwhelming activation, Craft is second, and Helm has very high focus. Archive turns mildly positive, but Lore, Hands and Stewards remain negative and Flow is inert, producing reconstruction with abundance concentrated in strategic capacity rather than ordinary life.

A huge central will drives a smaller industrial corps behind a positive Shield. Helm has extraordinary focus and Craft substantial focus, but Lore, Stewards, Hands, Flow and Archive are all negatively activated: the personality is a command economy building through pressure while consumption, welfare and free interpretation suffocate.

A watchful commander keeps the kingdom in armour: Shield and Helm hold the foreground, Stewards keep the centre supplied, and Archive is a modest clerk behind them. Lore and Flow barely stir while Craft and Hands are depleted, so imagination and ordinary work serve a proud but heavily guarded establishment.

This is an exhausted organism rather than a functioning command: all eight sigma values are negative, with Helm, Shield and Hands among the deepest losses. Stewards and Flow are only relatively less disabled, so the personality is one of failing provision, paralysed direction and a population no longer able to carry the war.

An industrial concierge works beside the guard: Shield leads, Stewards rises to second, and Craft, Flow and Lore carry positive activation while Helm nearly falls silent. The result is purposeful development brokered around an absent centre, with Hands still paying the human cost.

The armour loosens without disappearing: Shield still leads, but Helm, Lore and Archive become more attentive and Flow begins to move. Craft has some life while Hands and Stewards lag, making this a controlled opening directed from above rather than a confident liberation of everyday society.

This is a more tightly closed version of the keeper: Shield leads Helm, Stewards remains useful, and Archive supports routine order. Hands is again the most exhausted function and Lore remains subdued, while a moderate Craft survives at the edges of a fortress built around obedience.

A disciplined moderniser broadens its command: Shield leads Helm, with Flow, Archive and Stewards energetic and Craft supportive. Hands is the weak practical base and Lore is much quieter than the governing core, so confident competence and modernisation coexist with tightly limited dissent.

Flow and Hands become the practical leaders while Helm collapses and Stewards turns negative. Archive remains constructive, but Lore and Shield are quiet: the organisation responds through spending, work and delivery rather than persuasive leadership, becoming a crisis technician with a fractured political voice.

Archive leads a highly engaged coalition of Lore, Hands and Flow, while Helm and Shield step back from command. Stewards remains modest: the personality is a nation writing a new civic settlement, linking social ideas to housing, work and circulation rather than ruling through emergency discipline.

Craft takes the leading role in a broadly positive whole-of-nation mobilisation, with Helm and Shield focused rather than flamboyant. Archive, Lore, Hands and Stewards all share moderate activation, so this is a capable wartime organiser turning production into a wider plan for collective security.

The organisation loses work and direction together: Helm, Hands and Flow are deeply negative and Shield cannot compensate. Archive and Lore are the only positive channels, so it becomes a worried observer and keeper of accounts, searching for explanation and continuity while practical life shrinks.

Lore and Archive again lead, but at much lower intensity; Shield and Stewards give modest support while Helm and Hands are negative and Flow nearly stops. The result is a cautious cultural curator, making room for new social meanings while economic confidence and executive energy remain weak.

Craft and Shield take charge of sacrifice while Helm is deeply negative and Lore and Hands are depleted. Archive, Flow and Stewards barely hold their ground: the national personality is a producer and commemorator of war service whose political direction and ordinary confidence fracture under the strain.

Flow keeps moving while Helm and Lore lose their voice and confidence; Archive remains mildly constructive and Craft only just positive. Shield and Hands do little, making this a commercially active but politically frustrated system, still producing and exchanging while leadership repeatedly fails to carry a shared programme.

Flow dominates a capable, outwardly prosperous machine, with Archive, Craft and Stewards strongly supportive and Helm calmly focused. Shield is negative and Hands modest: the personality is a confident economic operator whose success in circulation and administration coexists with unease about protection, borders and social security.

Archive and Lore guide a mild rebuilding programme, with Craft useful and Helm and Shield subdued. Hands and Stewards are flat to negative: this is a planner settling schemes on paper and talking development confidently while implementation and household foundations remain fragile.

Lore and Archive lead Flow while Helm loses most of its energy and Hands and Stewards turn negative. Craft is still mildly useful: the personality is an insistent reformer and interpreter of national purpose, pursuing structural and historical arguments while employment and political confidence hurt.

Archive leads a cautious recovery of Helm and Flow, but Lore, Craft and Stewards remain negative and Shield and Hands barely activate. The personality is a careful administrator trying to restore normal economic process while national conversation, confidence in making and social care remain brittle.

Flow surges ahead of a strongly focused Helm, with Lore and Archive close behind and every function positive. Hands and Craft are much less energised than negotiation and circulation: this is a confident broker opening channels and rewriting rules, more interested in national bargaining and market connection than protecting established production.

Archive and Flow carry national capacity while Helm and Shield become negative and Lore is almost flat. Craft and Stewards remain constructive but Hands stalls: the personality is an institutionally rich society whose governing consensus has lost authority, with argument moving into new social channels rather than the old centre.

Lore and Archive blaze with reforming purpose while Helm, Flow and Hands lose activation and Shield contributes nothing. Craft survives modestly and Stewards is weak: the personality is a bold drafter and moral advocate whose programme outruns economic management and constitutional stability.

The new nation becomes an able institutional networker: Archive and Flow lead, Hands also rises strongly, and Helm becomes highly focused. Lore supports the national story while Shield and Stewards remain restrained, producing an inventive, administrative and materially confident founder rather than a security state.

A conversational constitution-maker thinks ahead: Lore leads Archive and Flow, all three positive, while Helm and Stewards are modest organisers. Shield and Hands lag, so this is a coalition of colonial talkers and designers imagining union more strongly than it can yet enforce or deliver it.

Only Archive remains positive; Helm, Hands, Craft, Flow and Lore all lose activation and Shield sits at zero. The personality is a tired emergency clerk keeping records and procedures intact while direction, livelihood, movement and meaning are compressed by protracted crisis.

Flow and Lore lead an expansive, optimistic society, with Archive, Stewards, Helm, Hands and Craft all strongly positive. Shield is the quietest function: this is an open-handed developer and storyteller, confident that growth, migration, homes and infrastructure can enlarge the nation without a siege mentality.

A restless maker keeps producing and circulating: Craft and Flow lead, Archive remains active, and Shield, Stewards and Hands all contribute. Lore and Helm sink to the bottom despite staying positive, leaving a capable but quarrelsome moderniser whose emancipatory argument and political authorship no longer match its technical momentum.

A practical reformer treats society as a system that can be adjusted: Stewards and Flow lead an all-positive ensemble, with Lore and Craft supplying explanation and technique. Hands remains the one weak instrument, so expertise, circulation and administrative ambition run ahead of ordinary labour's capacity to share the transformation.

The confident moderniser contracts into a careful custodian: Shield and Archive lead while Flow turns negative and Helm is most impaired. Craft, Lore and Stewards retain only modest capacity, so protection, scrutiny and record-keeping remain active as economic circulation and executive assurance lose their force.

A networked pioneer puts Flow in front, with Craft, Helm, Stewards and Lore in a dense, positive supporting band. Archive supplies dependable order and Shield stands back: invention, open circulation and confident stewardship make the future feel extensible without requiring protection to become the dominant story.

A vigilant archivist takes charge: Shield leads by a clear margin, Archive and Craft stand together second, and Stewards, Helm, Flow and Lore follow in descending confidence. Hands remains least engaged, so making, recording and defending become more salient than public interpretation or everyday agency.

Everyday capacity gives way: Craft, Helm, Stewards, Hands and Flow are negatively activated, with circulation and ordinary work deepest in damage. Shield leads only by default and Lore with Archive remain marginally functional, making a guarded, explanatory organism trying to comprehend collapse rather than a confident state directing recovery.

The nation becomes an industrial fighting collective: Craft leads, with Helm, Flow and Shield almost level behind it, and every function positive. Lore has focus equal to Helm, so war production, strategic command, logistics and public story operate together; low-ranked Hands and Stewards are supportive rather than absent.

Only Shield retains clear activation and Archive a smaller administrative residue while Craft, Hands, Stewards and Flow are all impaired. Helm and Lore fall furthest, leaving a wary organisation that protects procedures and boundaries after interpretive trust and political authorship have largely lost their ability to animate the whole.

An inventive rescuer thinks and talks its way back into action: Lore leads Helm, with Shield, Archive and Craft offering practical and institutional support. Flow is nearly stalled, Stewards slightly impaired and Hands still negative, so renewed legitimacy and programme-making outrun the recovery of ordinary livelihood.

A confident organiser rebuilds through Archive and Helm while Stewards, Craft, Flow and Lore regroup behind them and Shield holds the perimeter. Every function is positive, but Hands is almost inert: restored administrative purpose, market circulation and national confidence leave ordinary labour only marginally engaged.

The whole system becomes a purposeful crusader, with Stewards leading and Helm, Craft, Lore, Flow and Shield closely packed behind it. Archive and Hands are the rear rather than a broken flank: this is intensive, morally narrated mobilisation, not command by one node alone.

A confident, expansive household-builder lets Flow lead while Craft and Lore stay close behind, and every function remains positive. Archive and Stewards maintain the framework and Shield is comparatively subdued: production, distribution and a future-facing national story expand faster than the security apparatus needs to assert itself.

Technical and administrative machinery keeps moving after the political story breaks: Archive and Craft jointly lead, with Flow and Shield still strongly active. Lore turns negative and Helm falls to the bottom, producing a capable economic and institutional apparatus with no unifying executive account and an increasingly hostile interpretive field.

The guard and the administrator keep the structure upright: Shield and Archive lead, Craft and Flow continue, and Helm and Lore remain positive but secondary. Hands and Stewards are almost motionless, so the system resumes protected production and record-keeping without restoring the felt security of ordinary work and provision.

An exuberant distributor-manager puts Flow and Stewards in front while Lore, Helm and Craft eagerly explain and expand the good life. Shield is content to sit back, but Hands barely quickens: circulation, credit and prosperity acquire their own momentum while labour is carried rather than empowered.

Protection and record lead by a small margin over six otherwise tied, strongly positive functions. The system is balanced and energetic, but the limited contrast makes its specific personality elusive.
Craft and work dominate, with provisioning close behind and direction positive; the record is the weakest function. Productive cooperation occupies almost the whole personality.
Making and record become still more distinct, while work is forceful and explanation relatively weak. Productive competence and procedural continuity outweigh public interpretation.

Craft leads record, exchange and provisioning, while public explanation is the least prominent function. A capable production-and-administration complex operates with relatively little narrative emphasis.
The same practical and administrative pattern persists, with Craft first and Lore last. No new turning point appears in the supplied era means.

Record leads an unusually uniform positive ensemble in which every other function except protection is tied. Administrative continuity is the only distinguishable accent in an otherwise comprehensive recovery.
Craft and record lead, with work and exchange strong and protection much quieter. Productive adjustment and institutional continuity define the ensemble without a defensive cast.
The profile exactly repeats the previous productive pattern, with making and work at the front and documentary life weak. No adjacent-period distinction can be made from these eight means.
Making and provisioning remain ahead, with direction and work following and record almost negligible. The active system is practical and custodial rather than reflective or openly communicative.

The numerical portrait is unchanged from the preceding one: making, provisioning and work still lead a thin informational apparatus. On these means alone there is no discernible shift in organisational character.
Provisioning leads direction and making in a mostly active establishment, but the record is negative. The practical centre manages and makes more convincingly than it remembers or explains itself.
The same tied profile continues: work and craft lead, with administration and direction close behind. The ensemble is comprehensive but too flat to identify a new phase without external labels.
Craft and work lead together, with direction and record also strongly positive and explanation last. A broad practical mobilisation appears coherent at every node in this single observed year.
Explanation, work and record become the leaders while protection alone is negative. Public meaning and practical effort organise the ensemble without invoking a defensive centre.

Making and work again lead an unchanged positive ensemble, with provisioning next and Archive last. There is abundant practical coordination but no numerical signature that separates this interval from its neighbours.
The profile is unchanged: making, record and circulation lead an active organisation whose public voice is comparatively faint. These values cannot distinguish this period from the previous one.
The same fixed configuration persists: practical making and work lead while record, explanation and flow are secondary. The numbers do not register a new emotional or organisational turn.
Craft and provisioning lead, with work strongly engaged and record and explanation very small. Practical reform has more energy than documentary or public interpretation.
No numerical change separates this period from its predecessors; practical making and work remain tied in front. The personality is active and provisioned but undifferentiated.

Protection is the sole positive function, with command and speech deeply disabled and the record also weak. Coercion occupies the foreground because the capacities that could explain, direct or sustain collective life have fallen away.

Making leads protection and record, while command and exchange recede and provisioning becomes the weakest active function. Productive and administrative capacity remains impressive, but distribution and ordinary participation no longer match its intensity.
All functions are negative; routine work and making are only the least damaged. Command is the deepest failure, leaving small practical remnants inside a comprehensive loss of direction.
Craft and work offer narrow pockets of activity, with explanation still attentive but not energised. Direction and stewardship are the weakest parts, so initiative has no durable institutional home.

Making and exchange are only mildly impaired, but command is the weakest function of all. Productive effort and some informational work continue inside a system unable to supply coherent political authorship.

Direction and protection lead an exceptionally broad recovery in which every function is active. Command, learning and production reinforce each other, although provisioning is only barely positive and work remains the quieter partner.
Exchange and protection lead, with broad support from direction, making and provisioning. All eight functions are positive, though everyday work is much quieter than the organised networks around it.

Protection is the only nearly functioning function, while command, exchange and craft are heavily impaired. Coercive coherence stands out by default in an organisation approaching internal exhaustion.
Protection surges and record revives, while work and provisioning remain negative. Guarded coordination restores institutional life more successfully than it restores the everyday base.

Protection and making take the lead, backed by strong direction, exchange and stewardship. The whole system is active, but ordinary work again trails the concentrated productive and administrative apparatus.

Explanation and record revive while execution hovers near zero and command remains strongly negative. Imagination and documentation return before the organisation can reliably turn them into coordinated action.

Direction and protection become nearly co-equal leaders, with making, administration and exchange immediately behind. This is a highly concentrated but still broad-based organisation; work and stewardship are relatively less prominent than command.
All capacities are exhausted, with work, provisioning and flow merely less damaged than command and speech. This reads as grim maintenance under overwhelming pressure, not a confident mobilisation.

Explanation is almost alone in approaching life; record and direction are deeply disabled. A searching voice addresses a fractured organisation whose practical and custodial functions cannot answer it.

Making and circulation are the least disabled functions, while command is again the most exhausted. Practical experiment survives at the edges of an administrative and political order that cannot carry it.

Every function is depleted, with work and protection merely less impaired than the rest. Craft, direction and stewardship are among the weakest, giving a portrait of survival effort without a working centre.

Only the record and public explanation retain even a little life; direction, protection and circulation all buckle. This is an entity trying to describe an emergency after its capacity to act has already drained away.
Protection alone flourishes while command, speech, making, exchange and stewardship all fail. A hard perimeter holds together an organism whose everyday and intellectual life is under severe strain.

A cultivated keeper puts explanation and record far ahead of command, with modest support from provisioning and circulation. Ordinary work is nearly absent and protection is depleted, so the learned centre stands above a thin practical base.

Protection and making form a forceful pair with exchange close behind and direction strongly engaged. All functions are positive, yet work remains markedly weaker than the large systems coordinating and protecting it.

Record remains the clear leader, with stewardship and protection secondary; command, work and exchange are negative. Procedure and custodial capacity keep operating while political direction and common participation weaken.
Record and explanation survive while command nearly stalls and work, making and exchange turn negative. The administrative mind remains coherent after the practical machinery has lost its grip.

Record and stewardship lead strong exchange, with all functions positive and command less dominant than the administrative core. Prosperity looks organised and serviceable rather than improvisational.
Record, stewardship and craft remain positive, but command is deeply negative and explanation almost stops. A functioning administrative body has lost political authorship and a shared public story.

Record and stewardship displace exchange at the front; making and protection remain useful but direction is much subdued. Administration and provisioning carry an organised effort whose everyday workers are still depleted.

Record and stewardship lead a less productive system, with direction and protection useful but work and craft weak. Reorganisation is carried by custody, allocation and institutions rather than broad participation.
Record leads protection and explanation, while work is negative and flow thins. Institutions hold their shape through strain more successfully than the everyday economy does.

Exchange leads record and protection, while everyday work slips further below zero. The same expansive machinery continues, with administrative and commercial energy outrunning the conditions of ordinary labour.

Record dominates explanation, stewardship and protection, while command and especially work are weak. A talkative, carefully administered society preserves institutional motion without restoring a strong practical foundation.

Record remains dominant and explanation strengthens, while all eight functions are positive and the middle functions cluster closely. Institutional continuity accompanies a more expressive and diversified prosperity.

Record and explanation lead a broad, positive recovery, with protection, stewardship and exchange contributing. Everyday work is the least active function, so rebuilding is organised principally through institutions and public purposes.

Exchange and protection lead a highly active establishment, with record and stewardship close behind. Only everyday work is negative, creating a powerful institutional and commercial superstructure above a strained human base.

Record stays far ahead while craft becomes more active and Helm declines. Administrative confidence supports experiment, but work remains faint and the organisation’s centre of gravity is procedural rather than executive.
Record and explanation remain far stronger than production or exchange, and work is deeply depleted. Administrative and interpretive continuity holds up a polity whose economic base has narrowed.

Record leads stewardship, with protection and making positive but command, exchange and speech much weaker. Institutional custody and supply carry the collective effort more clearly than charismatic direction or open circulation.
Record and explanation again dominate a positive but unexciting system. Work stays negative and making is muted, leaving a capable administrative voice over a weak everyday foundation.

Record and explanation are the only clear leaders, while most practical capacities sit just below zero. Administrative continuity and public interpretation persist through a low-energy, weakly directed period.

Direction and exchange become near-equal leaders in an entirely positive ensemble. Independence of initiative, administration and movement now reinforce each other, while everyday work remains the least prominent contributor.

Record and explanation lead a cooler ensemble in which craft and work lose most of their energy. Interpretation and administration absorb a disturbance that practical production has not fully overcome.

Exchange rises still further beside equally strong record and stewardship, while protection turns negative. Material circulation and careful custody define the system almost without reference to defence.

Record and stewardship dominate while work becomes inert and exchange softens. Administration and provisioning preserve continuity more successfully than everyday activity during an episode of constraint.

Explanation and record remain positive as circulation collapses and command, protection and work turn negative. The national conversation survives a severe disruption of the networks on which material life depends.
Record leads a partial recovery of work and command, but protection and stewardship remain weak. Institutional organisation and ordinary activity return before a sense of security does.

Record and exchange lead a fully active and broadly balanced reconstruction, with direction and explanation close behind. Protection is quiet because nearly every other function supplies the coherence.
Record returns to first place and direction strengthens as exchange and craft fall back. Administrative guidance carries a cooler economy, with protection still a quiet or absent preoccupation.
Exchange surges far ahead, with stewardship and record forming the next tier and work strongly engaged. Wealth and provisioning dominate the personality rather than either spectacle or coercion.

Explanation and record dominate a modest practical system, with circulation useful but command almost inert and protection and work negative. A public mind and documentary culture form before a forceful governing apparatus.

Record, exchange and stewardship again lead, but protection falls further below zero and command remains secondary. Material and institutional confidence coexists with a conspicuous absence of defensive activation.

Record and exchange remain dominant, although direction and everyday work lose some intensity. Prosperous administration and circulation continue with less executive drive than in the earlier reconstruction.

Exchange, record and stewardship create a rich, tightly organised foreground, and everyday work is also strong. Protection is minimal, suggesting confidence supplied by prosperous institutions rather than guard function.

Explanation and record stand above badly impaired everyday and executive capacities; exchange holds a little life. The public voice and institutional memory outlast the material system and its protection.
